name: grokbot-telegram
description: Telegram MCP servers in one command: Bot API (send as your @bot) and MTProto user account (send as you).
author: Lotus015

scripts.build: npm run build --prefix packages/mcp-server && npm run build --prefix packages/mcp-user-server && node scripts/build-dist.mjs
scripts.test: npm test --prefix packages/mcp-server && npm test --prefix packages/mcp-user-server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix packages/mcp-server && npm run typecheck --prefix packages/mcp-user-server
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm test && npm run validate && npm run smoke
